description: Negative case for shoot_blocked_bearers_visible: when EVERY living bearer can reach the target, the 'NOT EVERY MODEL CAN SHOOT' notice must stay hidden and all 5 Rokkit launcha bearers must be declared. Guards against the notice becoming a permanent scold, and against the LoS filter on the auto-assign path over-dropping bearers that can legally fire. Same fixture and target as the blocked scenario, but the whole unit is parked clear of the tall area terrain, level with the target.
